actions.name: authenticate
actions.doc: Authenticates a client credential or token.

actions.name: refresh
actions.doc: Exchanges a refresh token for a fresh access/refresh pair.

actions.name: login
actions.doc: Authenticates an account with email and password.

actions.name: verify_scope
actions.doc: Verifies whether a player or user has the required authorization scope.

actions.name: register
actions.doc: Registers a new user account and profile in both auth and player_data.

actions.name: create_player
actions.doc: Creates a new player or user account with authentication credentials.

actions.name: anonymous
actions.doc: Creates or resumes an anonymous player session.

actions.name: set_display_name
actions.doc: Sets the signed-in player's display name.

actions.name: issue_token
actions.doc:
Issues a service token for an existing user or player account.

The token carries the account's scopes as they are when it authenticates; the `scopes`
parameter is accepted for older callers and ignored.

actions.name: list_tokens
actions.doc: Lists the tokens issued for an account: id, kind, creation, last use and expiry.

actions.name: revoke_token
actions.doc: Revokes a token (and the session it belongs to).

actions.name: purge_tokens
actions.doc: Deletes expired and revoked token rows. Cron calls this.

actions.name: list_users
actions.doc: Lists all registered user accounts and their assigned authorization scopes.

actions.name: reset_password
actions.doc: Resets the password for an existing account.

actions.name: update_user_roles
actions.doc: Updates authorization scopes/roles for a user account.

actions.name: delete_user
actions.doc: Deletes a user account and associated auth credentials.

actions.name: purge_disposable
actions.doc:
Removes every account that was created disposable, and nothing else.

A player is disposable because the caller said so when it registered — a test, a demo, a load
run. Nothing is inferred, so this is safe to call on a live cluster: it removes the guests and
leaves the players who signed up.

crons.name: purge_tokens
crons.description: Deletes expired and revoked token rows.

events.name: connection_lost
events.doc: Fired when the underlying database pool drops connection.

actions.name: exec
actions.doc: Runs an operation inside a namespace: a SQL statement with arguments, or a key-value command.

actions.name: provision_namespace
actions.doc: Creates, or refreshes, the isolated namespace (and its access rules) for an extension.

actions.name: drop_namespace
actions.doc: Removes an extension's namespace and everything in it.

actions.name: transaction
actions.doc: Runs statements (SQL with positional arguments) in order in one transaction, all or nothing; a failure names the statement index.

actions.name: introspect
actions.doc: Describes a table in engine-neutral terms: columns with logical types, nullability and the primary key.

actions.name: dialect
actions.doc: How to write SQL for this engine: placeholder and quoting style, upsert strategy and type names.

actions.name: apply_schema
actions.doc: Applies the safe changes that bring a namespace's tables in line with declared resources (logical `storage` types); an unsafe change applies nothing and is reported.

actions.name: run_migrations
actions.doc: Applies an extension's hand-written SQL migrations in version order.

actions.name: reset_table
actions.doc: Drops a table of a namespace, and its schema history.

actions.name: table_columns
actions.doc: Lists the columns of a table in a namespace.

actions.name: connection_config
actions.doc: Retrieves namespaced database connection details.

actions.name: health_check
actions.doc: Performs a low-level ping to verify the database is reachable.

actions.name: register
actions.doc: Registers a game version in `dev`, with the extension versions it locks.

actions.name: set_locks
actions.doc: Changes the locks of a `dev` game version. Live, outdated and blocked versions are immutable.

actions.name: promote
actions.doc: Makes a `dev` game version live. The previous live one becomes `outdated`.

actions.name: block
actions.doc: Blocks a game version: its clients are told to upgrade.

actions.name: list
actions.doc: Lists game versions, newest first.

actions.name: resolve
actions.doc: Status and extension locks of one game version, as a client reports it.

events.name: player_created
events.doc: Emitted when a new player account is created.

events.name: player_deleted
events.doc: Emitted when a player account is deleted.

actions.name: get_player
actions.doc: Retrieves player profile record.

actions.name: create_player
actions.doc: Creates a player profile record, optionally linked to a user account.

actions.name: delete_player
actions.doc: Deletes a player profile record.

actions.name: retain_player
actions.doc: Unlinks user and marks player record as retained/orphaned for data retention policies.

actions.name: list_players
actions.doc: Lists all registered player profiles with optional filtering (all, valid, orphaned).

actions.name: update_player
actions.doc: Updates player profile record.

actions.name: get_data
actions.doc: Retrieves a fine-grained key-value JSON state entry for a player.

actions.name: set_data
actions.doc: Sets a fine-grained key-value JSON state entry for a player.

actions.name: delete_data
actions.doc: Deletes a fine-grained key-value JSON state entry for a player.

actions.name: get_all_data
actions.doc: Retrieves all key-value state entries for a player as a map.

actions.name: broadcast
actions.doc: Broadcasts a frame to an active WebSocket topic.

actions.name: connection_count
actions.doc: Retrieves current active WebSocket connection count.

actions.name: migrate
actions.doc: Creates/updates the tables backing all declared resources (additive migrations).

actions.name: provision
actions.doc: Provisioning step before an extension starts: makes the tables of its typed resources (those that declare column storage types).

actions.name: list
actions.doc: Lists rows for a resource with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

actions.name: get
actions.doc: Fetches one row by primary key.

actions.name: create
actions.doc: Creates a row.

actions.name: update
actions.doc: Updates a row by primary key.

actions.name: delete
actions.doc: Deletes a row by primary key.

actions.name: upsert
actions.doc: Inserts or updates a row on conflict.

actions.name: clear
actions.doc: Removes every row of a resource, table-backed or KV-backed, without dropping the table.

actions.name: recent_events
actions.doc: The most recent cluster events, newest first.

actions.name: error_groups
actions.doc: Failures grouped by fingerprint: counts, first/last seen, callers, and a sample request.

actions.name: capture
actions.doc: Starts a deep capture for one player, one action, or the whole cluster, for a few minutes.

actions.name: captures
actions.doc: The active deep captures, with their remaining seconds.

actions.name: stop_capture
actions.doc: Stops one capture (or every capture when kind is global and the value is blank).

actions.name: replay
actions.doc: Replays a captured invocation's full request as the caller who made it.

actions.name: health
actions.doc: Per-action health: 30-minute rates, lifetime p50/p95, and what needs attention.

actions.name: events
actions.doc: One page of stored events, filtered; ranges older than the hot window come from the archive.

actions.name: timeline
actions.doc: One request's timeline (or one caller's recent activity): calls, events, logs and failures.

actions.name: clear_events
actions.doc: Drops the in-memory ring and the persisted event history.

actions.name: purge_events
actions.doc: Drops one caller's hot events (account deletion); archived files are left untouched.

actions.name: status
actions.doc: Returns transport layer status.

actions.name: usage
actions.doc: Rolls up persisted usage per extension and action for this title.

actions.name: resolve_view
actions.doc: Resolves the LiveView component module for a given service or extension id.

actions.name: list_views
actions.doc: Lists all registered custom dashboard view modules.

actions.name: get_dashboard_mount
actions.doc: Retrieves dashboard mount specification: {:live, Module} | {:hook, config} | {:iframe, config}

actions.name: get_dashboard_data
actions.doc: Retrieves data payload for hydrating the dashboard view.

actions.name: list_chapters
actions.doc: Lists all available documentation chapters.

actions.name: get_chapter
actions.doc: Retrieves the content of a specific documentation chapter.

actions.name: export_docs
actions.doc: Exports the consolidated documentation and dynamic API reference as Markdown or HTML.

actions.name: status
actions.doc: Returns HTTP server status and registered route summaries.

actions.name: upload_file
actions.doc: Stores a file in a specified bucket from raw binary or base64 content.

actions.name: get_file_info
actions.doc: Retrieves metadata and local storage path for a file.

actions.name: read_file
actions.doc: Reads raw binary content of a file.

actions.name: list_files
actions.doc: Lists stored files within a bucket or across all buckets.

actions.name: list_buckets
actions.doc: Lists all storage buckets with their visibility (`public` or `private`).

actions.name: set_bucket_visibility
actions.doc:
Sets a bucket's visibility. `public` lets anyone download its files by URL; `private` (the
default) serves them only to staff or through a `signed_url`. Staff-only; an extension that owns
a bucket resolves its own files and marks the bucket public at start.

actions.name: update_file
actions.doc: Modifies an existing file's name, metadata, or content.

actions.name: signed_url
actions.doc:
Returns a time-limited download URL for one file. Server-only: an extension decides who may
read a file and mints the link; the HTTP file route accepts it without a token until it expires.

actions.name: authorize_download
actions.doc: Whether an unauthenticated download may be served: a public bucket, or a valid signed URL.

actions.name: delete_file
actions.doc: Deletes a stored file.

actions.name: execute
actions.doc: Executes a driver-agnostic query or data operation.

actions.name: table_columns
actions.doc: Lists the columns of a table in an extension's isolated database.

events.name: project_metadata_updated
events.doc: Broadcast when project metadata is updated.

actions.name: get_dashboard_mount
actions.doc: Retrieves dashboard mount specification: {:live, Module} | {:hook, config} | {:iframe, config}

actions.name: get_dashboard_data
actions.doc: Retrieves data payload for hydrating the dashboard view.

actions.name: get_project_metadata
actions.doc: Retrieves global project metadata.

actions.name: update_project_metadata
actions.doc: Updates global project metadata.

actions.name: status
actions.doc: Returns status and count of active cron jobs.

actions.name: list_jobs
actions.doc: Lists all scheduled cron jobs.

actions.name: trigger_job
actions.doc: Manually triggers a scheduled job by its name or id.

actions.name: list_extensions
actions.doc: Lists all registered extensions with their metadata and contracts.

actions.name: get_extension
actions.doc: Retrieves details and contract metadata for a single extension.

actions.name: get_system_info
actions.doc: Retrieves runtime node health, memory, and cluster stats.

actions.name: upload_extension
actions.doc: Uploads and installs a new extension binary.

actions.name: remove_extension
actions.doc: Removes an installed extension.

actions.name: reset_instance
actions.doc: Wipes the instance: mode `extensions` removes every non-standard extension with its data and files; mode `everything` also removes players, accounts (not admin/studio), service tokens, game versions, Studio settings and file buckets.

actions.name: restart_system
actions.doc: Triggers a system re-index and reload of all extensions.

actions.name: logs
actions.doc: Returns the most recent log lines an extension emitted.

actions.name: reload_extension
actions.doc: Re-boots an installed extension from its staged files, without re-uploading it.

actions.name: export_extension_info
actions.doc: Exports the complete catalog of extensions and contracts for external tools (CLI/Unity).

actions.name: csharp_attributes
actions.doc: Exports C# companion attributes and types provided by loaded extensions.
